url-codec.NAME: URL Encode / Decode
url-codec.DESCRIPTION: Percent-encode and decode URLs and query parameters.
url-codec.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Percent-encode and decode strings using URL encoding. Paste a URL or query parameter and get the encoded or decoded version instantly. Useful for building valid URLs, debugging APIs and handling special characters in HTTP parameters.

base64.NAME: Base64 / UnBase64
base64.DESCRIPTION: Encode and decode plain text safely using Base64.
base64.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Encode plain text to Base64 and decode Base64 strings back to readable text. Used for data URIs, HTTP Basic Auth headers, email attachments and binary-safe data transmission in text-only systems.

jwt.NAME: JWT Decoder
jwt.DESCRIPTION: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens — header, payload and signature.
jwt.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens without a key: view the header, algorithm, payload claims and expiry. Optionally verify the signature with your HMAC secret or RSA public key. All computation runs in your browser.

codice-fiscale.NAME: Codice Fiscale
codice-fiscale.DESCRIPTION: Generate Italian tax code from personal details.
codice-fiscale.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Calculate the Italian fiscal code (codice fiscale) from name, surname, date of birth, gender and municipality of birth, using the official Agenzia delle Entrate algorithm. All computation runs in your browser without sending any data to a server.

cf-checker.NAME: Codice Fiscale Checker
cf-checker.DESCRIPTION: Validate the control character of an Italian fiscal code via generic regex + checksum.
cf-checker.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Verify an Italian fiscal code by checking the format with a generic regex pattern and the control character with the checksum algorithm. Does not verify registry existence of the person.

codice-fiscale-inverso.NAME: Reverse Fiscal Code
codice-fiscale-inverso.DESCRIPTION: Decode an Italian fiscal code — extract birth date, gender and municipality.
codice-fiscale-inverso.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Given an Italian fiscal code, this tool parses its structure to extract the encoded data: birth year, month and day, gender, and birth municipality or cadastral code. Validation runs directly in your browser.

iban-checker.NAME: IBAN Checker
iban-checker.DESCRIPTION: Validate IBAN check digits (mod-97). Format check only — no bank lookup.
iban-checker.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Validate the check digits of an IBAN using the ISO 7064 Mod 97-10 algorithm. Covers 40+ countries. Performs format check only — does not verify actual bank account existence.

one-line.NAME: To One Line
one-line.DESCRIPTION: Collapse multi-line text to a single line and remove extra spaces.
one-line.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Collapse multi-line text into a single line by removing line breaks and multiple spaces. Ideal for cleaning SQL queries, JSON strings or any multiline content before pasting into terminals or variables.

space-remover.NAME: Space Remover
space-remover.DESCRIPTION: Strip all whitespace characters from any text.
space-remover.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Remove all whitespace characters from text: spaces, tabs, newlines and non-breaking spaces. Useful for normalizing identifiers, hashes, API keys or any string where spaces cause errors.

string-length.NAME: String Length
string-length.DESCRIPTION: Count characters, words, lines and byte size of any text.
string-length.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Count the number of characters, words, lines and byte size of any text. Useful for checking database field limits, tweet length, SMS length or any text with size constraints.

unit-converter.NAME: Unit Converter
unit-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert SI metric units to US customary units — length, mass, volume, temperature, speed.
unit-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert between metric SI units and US customary units and vice versa. Supports length, mass, volume, temperature and speed. Instant client-side calculation.

json-formatter.NAME: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.DESCRIPTION: Pretty-print, minify and validate JSON documents.
json-formatter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Format and prettify JSON documents with configurable indentation. Minify JSON by removing unnecessary whitespace. Validate syntax and surface errors. Useful for reading API responses and config files.

json-yaml.NAME: JSON ↔ YAML
json-yaml.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Bidirectionally convert between JSON and YAML. Paste JSON and get YAML, or paste YAML and get JSON. Useful for configuring Kubernetes manifests, Docker Compose files and other infrastructure.

json-csv.NAME: JSON ↔ CSV
json-csv.DESCRIPTION: Convert between JSON arrays of objects and CSV.
json-csv.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert JSON arrays of objects to downloadable CSV and CSV back to JSON arrays. Automatically detects columns from object keys. Useful for importing and exporting data from spreadsheets or databases.

epoch.NAME: Epoch / Unix Timestamp
epoch.DESCRIPTION: Convert between Unix epoch timestamps and human-readable dates.
epoch.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert between Unix epoch timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) and human-readable dates. Displays the current time in real time. Useful for debugging logs, inspecting API timestamps and working with dates in databases.

cron.NAME: Cron Expression Builder
cron.DESCRIPTION: Explain and design cron expressions (5 or 6 fields), à la crontab.guru.
cron.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Explain cron expressions in plain language and show the next scheduled execution dates. Build expressions with a visual interface. Equivalent to crontab.guru. Supports 5 and 6-field expressions.

password-hash.NAME: Password Hash
password-hash.DESCRIPTION: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes. bcrypt requires a server.
password-hash.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Compute cryptographic hashes MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 of any text, entirely in your browser. Useful for verifying file integrity, comparing hashed passwords and studying cryptographic algorithms.

password-generator.NAME: Password Generator
password-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate strong passwords using a cryptographically-secure random generator.
password-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate strong passwords using a cryptographically secure pseudorandom number generator (CSPRNG). Configure length, uppercase, numbers and symbols. No passwords are sent to any external server.

my-ip.NAME: My IP
my-ip.DESCRIPTION: Discover your public IP address (the only tool that performs a network request).
my-ip.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Display your public IP address by fetching it from an external service. This is the only tool in this suite that makes a network request. Useful for checking your connection, VPN or proxy status.

cidr-subnet-calculator.NAME: CIDR / Subnet Calculator
cidr-subnet-calculator.DESCRIPTION: Analyze CIDR blocks and calculate subnet mask, network, broadcast and usable IPs.
cidr-subnet-calculator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter an IPv4 CIDR block such as 192.168.1.42/24 to calculate subnet mask, wildcard mask, network address, broadcast address and how many IP addresses are available. Everything runs locally in the browser.

ip-subnet-calculator.NAME: IP + Subnet Mask Calculator
ip-subnet-calculator.DESCRIPTION: Enter an IP and subnet mask or prefix to calculate the network and available IP addresses.
ip-subnet-calculator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Provide an IPv4 address together with a subnet mask like 255.255.255.0 or a prefix like /24 to calculate the network range, broadcast address, first and last host, and the total number of available IP addresses.

percentage.NAME: Percentage Calculator
percentage.DESCRIPTION: Calculate percentages, ratios and percentage changes.
percentage.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Calculate percentages, ratios and percentage changes between two values. Supports percentage of a value, value from a percentage and percentage change between two numbers.

iva-calculator.NAME: IVA Calculator
iva-calculator.DESCRIPTION: Calculate prices with and without Italian VAT using rates: 4%, 5%, 10%, 22%.
iva-calculator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Calculate prices with and without Italian VAT (IVA) using standard Italian rates: 4%, 5%, 10% and 22%. Useful for invoices, quotes and accounting.

discount-calculator.NAME: Discount Calculator
discount-calculator.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the discounted price from the original price and a discount percentage.
discount-calculator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter the original price and a discount percentage to instantly get the final discounted price and the amount saved.

uuid-generator.NAME: UUID / ULID Generator
uuid-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 and ULID identifiers.
uuid-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate cryptographically secure UUID v4 and ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier) identifiers. Generate single or multiple with one click. Everything runs in your browser.

regex-tester.NAME: Regex Tester
regex-tester.DESCRIPTION: Test regular expressions in real time with match highlighting.
regex-tester.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Test JavaScript regular expressions in real time with match highlighting on the input text. Supports global, case-insensitive, multiline and other flags. Shows all capture groups.

diff-checker.NAME: Diff Checker
diff-checker.DESCRIPTION: Compare two texts line by line and highlight the differences.
diff-checker.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Compare two texts line by line, highlighting added, removed and changed lines. Useful for reviewing changes to code, documents or configurations without using Git.

base-converter.NAME: Number Base Converter
base-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal.
base-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert numbers between binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10) and hexadecimal (base 16). Instant conversion into all bases simultaneously.

case-converter.NAME: Case Converter
case-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and other formats.
case-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, UPPER_CASE, lowercase and Title Case. Useful for developers working with variable names, functions, classes and URLs.

word-counter.NAME: Word Counter
word-counter.DESCRIPTION: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and estimate reading time.
word-counter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Count words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, lines and estimate reading time. Also shows byte size. Useful for articles, tweets, SMS and field length limits.

slug-generator.NAME: Slug Generator
slug-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate SEO-friendly URL slugs from any text, removing accents and special characters.
slug-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate SEO-friendly URL slugs from any title or text. Removes accents, converts to lowercase, replaces spaces with hyphens and strips special characters. Also supports underscore separator.

age-calculator.NAME: Age Calculator
age-calculator.DESCRIPTION: Calculate exact age in years, months and days from a birth date.
age-calculator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Calculate exact age in years, months and days from a birth date. Also shows the days until the next birthday and the total number of days lived.

html-encoder.NAME: HTML Encode / Decode
html-encoder.DESCRIPTION: Encode and decode HTML entities. Convert special characters to HTML entities and back.
html-encoder.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Encode special HTML characters to entities (e.g. < → <) and decode HTML entities back to readable characters. Useful for embedding code in articles, documentation or HTML attributes.

color-converter.NAME: Color Converter
color-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL with a live visual preview.
color-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL formats with a live visual preview. Copy the value in your preferred format with one click. Useful for designers and front-end developers.

hex-to-rgb.NAME: HEX → RGB
hex-to-rgb.DESCRIPTION: Convert a HEX color code to RGB values instantly.
hex-to-rgb.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter any HEX color code and instantly get the corresponding RGB values. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the CSS rgb() value with one click.

hex-to-hsl.NAME: HEX → HSL
hex-to-hsl.DESCRIPTION: Convert a HEX color code to HSL values instantly.
hex-to-hsl.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter any HEX color code and instantly get the corresponding HSL values. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the CSS hsl() value with one click.

rgb-to-hex.NAME: RGB → HEX
rgb-to-hex.DESCRIPTION: Convert RGB color values to a HEX color code instantly.
rgb-to-hex.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter R, G, B values (0-255) and instantly get the corresponding HEX color code. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the value with one click.

hsl-to-hex.NAME: HSL → HEX
hsl-to-hex.DESCRIPTION: Convert HSL color values to a HEX color code instantly.
hsl-to-hex.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter H (0-360), S (0-100%) and L (0-100%) values and instantly get the corresponding HEX color code. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the value with one click.

rgb-to-hsl.NAME: RGB → HSL
rgb-to-hsl.DESCRIPTION: Convert RGB color values to HSL instantly.
rgb-to-hsl.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter R, G, B values (0-255) and instantly get the corresponding HSL values. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the CSS hsl() value with one click.

hsl-to-rgb.NAME: HSL → RGB
hsl-to-rgb.DESCRIPTION: Convert HSL color values to RGB instantly.
hsl-to-rgb.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Enter H (0-360), S (0-100%) and L (0-100%) values and instantly get the corresponding RGB values. Displays a live color preview and lets you copy the CSS rgb() value with one click.

lorem-ipsum.NAME: Lorem Ipsum Generator
lorem-ipsum.DESCRIPTION: Generate Lorem Ipsum placeholder text for mockups and prototypes.
lorem-ipsum.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate Lorem Ipsum placeholder text for mockups, wireframes and prototypes. Choose the number of paragraphs, sentences or words. Classic or modern variant.

sql-formatter.NAME: SQL Formatter
sql-formatter.DESCRIPTION: Format and beautify SQL queries with automatic indentation.
sql-formatter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Format and beautify SQL queries with automatic indentation and keyword capitalization. Supports major SQL dialects. Useful for making complex or auto-generated queries readable.

date-diff.NAME: Date Difference
date-diff.DESCRIPTION: Calculate the exact difference between two dates in days, weeks, months and years.
date-diff.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Calculate the exact difference between two dates in days, weeks, months and years. Useful for computing deadlines, contract durations, years of work experience and days until an event.

timezone-converter.NAME: Time Zone Converter
timezone-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert a time between the world's major time zones.
timezone-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert a time between the world's major time zones. Useful for scheduling international meetings, understanding when a remote team is available or converting server log timestamps.

partita-iva.NAME: Partita IVA Validator
partita-iva.DESCRIPTION: Verify the validity of an Italian VAT number (Partita IVA) using the checksum algorithm.
partita-iva.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Verify the formal validity of an Italian VAT number (Partita IVA) using the official checksum algorithm. Checks format and control digit only — does not verify whether the VAT number is active or registered.

hmac-generator.NAME: HMAC Generator
hmac-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate HMAC SHA-256 and SHA-512 signatures with a secret key for APIs and auth.
hmac-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate HMAC SHA-256 and SHA-512 signatures with a secret key. Used for authenticating API requests, webhooks and secure communications. All computation runs in your browser.

random-token.NAME: Random Token / Secret
random-token.DESCRIPTION: Generate cryptographically secure random tokens for API keys, JWT secrets and passwords.
random-token.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate cryptographically secure random tokens in HEX or Base64 format. Useful for API keys, JWT secrets, nonces, CSRF tokens and any application requiring secure randomness.

roman-numbers.NAME: Roman Numerals
roman-numbers.DESCRIPTION: Convert Arabic numbers to Roman numerals and vice versa. From I to MMMCMXCIX.
roman-numbers.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert Arabic numbers to Roman numerals and vice versa. Supports values from 1 to 3999 (MMMCMXCIX). Useful for titles, dates, chapters and historical notation.

number-words.NAME: Number to Words
number-words.DESCRIPTION: Convert numbers to Italian words. E.g. 1234 → milleduecentotrentaquattro.
number-words.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert integers to Italian words. For example: 1234 → milleduecentotrentaquattro. Useful for writing cheques, invoices, notarial deeds and formal documents.

jpg-to-webp.NAME: JPG → WebP
jpg-to-webp.DESCRIPTION: Convert JPG/JPEG images to WebP format with quality control.
jpg-to-webp.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert JPG/JPEG images to WebP format directly in your browser. Reduce image file size while maintaining high visual quality. WebP is supported by all modern browsers.

png-to-webp.NAME: PNG → WebP
png-to-webp.DESCRIPTION: Convert PNG images to WebP format with quality control.
png-to-webp.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert PNG images to WebP format directly in your browser, preserving transparency. Reduce image weight to improve website performance.

webp-converter.NAME: WebP → PNG / JPG
webp-converter.DESCRIPTION: Convert WebP images to PNG or JPG. Compatible with all browsers.
webp-converter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert WebP images to PNG or JPG directly in your browser. Useful for sharing images on systems that do not yet support the WebP format.

image-resizer.NAME: Image Resizer
image-resizer.DESCRIPTION: Resize images by setting width and height. Maintain aspect ratio.
image-resizer.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Resize images by setting custom width and height. Maintain the original aspect ratio or set dimensions freely. Resizing happens client-side without uploading files to a server.

image-to-base64.NAME: Image to Base64
image-to-base64.DESCRIPTION: Convert image files to Base64 strings or data URLs and download the result as TXT when needed.
image-to-base64.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert PNG, JPG, WebP and other image files to Base64 strings or full data URLs entirely in the browser. Useful for CSS embeds, HTML snippets, placeholders and debugging. When the output is too long, you can download it as a .txt file.

image-compressor.NAME: Image Compressor
image-compressor.DESCRIPTION: Compress images with real-time quality control. See the size reduction live.
image-compressor.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Compress images by reducing JPEG quality with a real-time preview. Immediately see the byte size reduction before downloading the compressed file.

image-crop.NAME: Image Crop
image-crop.DESCRIPTION: Crop images with an interactive selector. Drag to select the area.
image-crop.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Crop images with an interactive selector. Drag and resize the selection area, then download the cropped image. Everything runs in your browser without uploading files.

tira-il-dado.NAME: Roll the Dice
tira-il-dado.DESCRIPTION: Roll one or more virtual dice: D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100.
tira-il-dado.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Roll one or more virtual dice: D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20 and D100. Ideal for tabletop RPGs, random decisions and simulations. Results are generated with a cryptographically secure random generator.

numero-random.NAME: Random Number
numero-random.DESCRIPTION: Extract one or more random numbers in a custom range.
numero-random.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Extract one or more random numbers in a custom range. Useful for draws, lotteries, statistical sampling and any situation requiring verifiable randomness.

testa-o-croce.NAME: Heads or Tails
testa-o-croce.DESCRIPTION: Flip a virtual coin: heads or tails. With flip history.
testa-o-croce.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Flip a virtual coin: heads or tails. Keeps a history of all flips with real-time statistics. Results are generated with a cryptographically secure random generator.

camel-case.NAME: camelCase Converter
camel-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to camelCase — ideal for variable and function names.
camel-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to camelCase format, perfect for naming JavaScript and TypeScript variables, functions and methods. Example: «hello world» → «helloWorld». Handles accents, spaces and special characters.

pascal-case.NAME: PascalCase Converter
pascal-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to PascalCase — ideal for class and component names.
pascal-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to PascalCase format, perfect for naming classes, components, interfaces and types. Example: «hello world» → «HelloWorld». Handles accents, spaces and special characters.

snake-case.NAME: snake_case Converter
snake-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to snake_case — ideal for Python variables and database columns.
snake-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to snake_case format, widely used in Python, Ruby and SQL. Example: «hello world» → «hello_world». Handles accents, spaces and special characters.

kebab-case.NAME: kebab-case Converter
kebab-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to kebab-case — ideal for CSS classes and URL slugs.
kebab-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to kebab-case format, commonly used in HTML attributes, CSS class names and URL slugs. Example: «hello world» → «hello-world». Handles accents, spaces and special characters.

constant-case.NAME: CONSTANT_CASE Converter
constant-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to CONSTANT_CASE — ideal for constants and environment variables.
constant-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to CONSTANT_CASE (also known as SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE), widely used for constants, enum values and environment variables. Example: «hello world» → «HELLO_WORLD».

upper-case.NAME: UPPER CASE Converter
upper-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to UPPER CASE — all characters uppercase.
upper-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to full uppercase. Example: «hello world» → «HELLO WORLD». Preserves spacing, numbers and punctuation.

lower-case.NAME: lower case Converter
lower-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to lower case — all characters lowercase.
lower-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to full lowercase. Example: «Hello World» → «hello world». Preserves spacing, numbers and punctuation.

title-case.NAME: Title Case Converter
title-case.DESCRIPTION: Convert text to Title Case — first letter of each word capitalized.
title-case.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert any text to Title Case where the first letter of each word is capitalized. Example: «hello world» → «Hello World». Useful for headings, titles and proper names.

color-picker.NAME: Color Picker
color-picker.DESCRIPTION: Pick a color visually and get HEX, RGB and HSL values instantly.
color-picker.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Pick any color visually and instantly get the corresponding HEX, RGB and HSL values. Copy values with one click. Useful for designers and front-end developers working with CSS and design systems.

favicon-generator.NAME: Favicon Generator
favicon-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate a favicon.ico from any image in the browser.
favicon-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate a favicon.ico file from any image directly in your browser. Creates a multi-size ICO file (16×16, 32×32, 48×48) without any server upload. Download and use on any website.

credit-card-validator.NAME: Credit Card Validator
credit-card-validator.DESCRIPTION: Validate card numbers with the Luhn algorithm and detect the card network.
credit-card-validator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Validate credit card numbers using the Luhn algorithm and automatically detect the card network (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover and more). Useful for front-end form validation and testing payment flows.

semver-checker.NAME: Semver Comparator
semver-checker.DESCRIPTION: Compare semantic versions and check if a version satisfies a range.
semver-checker.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Compare semantic version numbers and verify whether a version satisfies a semver range (npm-style). Useful for managing package dependencies, CI/CD pipelines and version compatibility checks.

qr-generator.NAME: QR Code Generator
qr-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate custom QR codes from text or URLs with PNG download.
qr-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate custom QR codes from any text, URL, phone number or email address. Customize size and download as a PNG image. All generation runs directly in your browser.

barcode-generator.NAME: Barcode Generator
barcode-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate 1D barcodes online: CODE128, EAN13, EAN8, UPC, ITF14, MSI, Pharmacode.
barcode-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate 1D barcodes online directly in your browser. Supports CODE128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ITF-14, MSI and Pharmacode. Instant preview and PNG download. No server upload required.

barcode-reader.NAME: Barcode Reader
barcode-reader.DESCRIPTION: Read barcodes from images with local browser-based recognition.
barcode-reader.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Scan and decode barcodes from uploaded images or photos directly in your browser. Supports EAN, UPC, CODE128 and other common 1D barcode formats. No data is sent to any server.

qrcode-reader.NAME: QR Code Reader
qrcode-reader.DESCRIPTION: Decode QR codes from images and copy the extracted content.
qrcode-reader.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Upload or drag an image containing a QR code to decode it instantly in your browser. Extracts URLs, text, contact info and any other QR-encoded data. No server upload required.

text-inverter.NAME: Text Inverter
text-inverter.DESCRIPTION: Reverse text by characters, words or lines.
text-inverter.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Reverse any text by characters, words or lines. Useful for generating mirror text, reversing word order in sentences or flipping line order in multi-line content.

find-replace.NAME: Find & Replace
find-replace.DESCRIPTION: Find and replace text with regex, case-sensitive and global support.
find-replace.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Find and replace text with support for plain text and regular expressions, case-sensitive matching and global replacement. Useful for bulk text transformations, code snippets and template editing.

image-rotate.NAME: Image Rotate
image-rotate.DESCRIPTION: Rotate images by any angle with a live preview.
image-rotate.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Rotate images by any custom angle directly in your browser. Preview the result in real time and download the rotated image. Supports all common image formats including JPG, PNG and WebP.

image-flip.NAME: Image Flip
image-flip.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Flip images horizontally (mirror) or vertically directly in your browser. Preview the result instantly and download the flipped image. Supports all common image formats.

image-watermark.NAME: Image Watermark
image-watermark.DESCRIPTION: Add a text watermark to images directly in the browser.
image-watermark.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Add a custom text watermark to any image directly in your browser. Configure position, font size, color and opacity. Download the watermarked image without uploading to any server.

palette-generator.NAME: Palette Generator
palette-generator.DESCRIPTION: Generate a color palette from a base color using HEX input and color picker.
palette-generator.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Generate a full color palette from a single base color. Enter a HEX code or use the color picker to get complementary, analogous and triadic color schemes. Useful for UI design and brand identity.

palette-from-image.NAME: Palette from Image
palette-from-image.DESCRIPTION: Extract dominant colors from any photo or screenshot.
palette-from-image.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Extract the most dominant colors from any uploaded image or screenshot. Useful for matching brand colors, creating design systems inspired by a photo or quickly identifying a color scheme.

pdf-merge.NAME: PDF Merge
pdf-merge.DESCRIPTION: Merge multiple PDF files into a single document. Reorder files before combining.
pdf-merge.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document directly in your browser. Add as many files as needed, reorder them with arrows, then merge and download the result instantly. No uploads, no server processing.

pdf-split.NAME: PDF Split
pdf-split.DESCRIPTION: Split a PDF into individual pages. Download pages separately or all at once.
pdf-split.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Split any PDF into its individual pages — each page becomes a separate downloadable PDF file. Download pages one by one or all at once. Everything runs client-side with no file uploads.

pdf-compress.NAME: PDF Compressor
pdf-compress.DESCRIPTION: Optimize a PDF's internal structure to reduce its file size.
pdf-compress.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Reduce PDF file size by optimizing its internal structure (object streams) without altering the visual content. For already-optimized PDFs the savings may be minimal. All processing happens entirely in your browser.

pdf-rotate.NAME: PDF Rotate
pdf-rotate.DESCRIPTION: Rotate PDF pages by 90°, 180° or 270°. Apply to all pages or a selection.
pdf-rotate.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Rotate all pages or a custom range of pages in any PDF by 90°, 180° or 270°. Specify pages with a range like «1-3, 5» and download the rotated PDF instantly. No server upload required.

pdf-reorder.NAME: PDF Reorder Pages
pdf-reorder.DESCRIPTION: Change the order of PDF pages using up/down arrows.
pdf-reorder.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Rearrange the pages of any PDF using simple up/down arrow buttons. Load a PDF, reorder its pages as needed, then download the reordered document. All processing is done locally in your browser.

pdf-extract.NAME: PDF Extract Pages
pdf-extract.DESCRIPTION: Extract a range of pages from a PDF and save them as a new document.
pdf-extract.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Extract specific pages from any PDF by specifying a page range like «1-3, 5, 8-10». The selected pages are saved into a new PDF file you can download immediately. Everything runs client-side.

pdf-viewer.NAME: PDF Viewer
pdf-viewer.DESCRIPTION: Open and view PDF files directly in your browser without installing anything.
pdf-viewer.LONG_DESCRIPTION: View any PDF file directly in your browser using the native PDF renderer. No plugins, no uploads, no external services. Load a file and start reading immediately.

pdf-to-image.NAME: PDF to Images
pdf-to-image.DESCRIPTION: Convert each page of a PDF to a high-resolution PNG image.
pdf-to-image.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Convert every page of a PDF into a PNG image at adjustable resolution. Download images individually or all at once. Rendering runs entirely in your browser using a WebAssembly PDF engine.

image-to-pdf.NAME: Images to PDF
image-to-pdf.DESCRIPTION: Convert one or more images (JPG, PNG) to a PDF. Each image becomes a page.
image-to-pdf.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Combine one or more JPG or PNG images into a single PDF document. Each image is placed on its own page. Add multiple files, reorder them with arrows, then create and download the PDF — all in the browser.

stopwatch.NAME: Stopwatch
stopwatch.DESCRIPTION: Online stopwatch with lap times and split times. Accurate to the hundredth of a second.
stopwatch.LONG_DESCRIPTION: A precise online stopwatch with lap time tracking. Measure elapsed time with hundredth-of-a-second precision, record split times and review your full lap history. Runs entirely in your browser.

countdown-timer.NAME: Countdown Timer
countdown-timer.DESCRIPTION: Countdown timer with hours, minutes and seconds. Progress bar and expiry alert.
countdown-timer.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Set a custom countdown in hours, minutes and seconds. Watch the progress bar fill and receive a visual and audio alert when time runs out. The timer runs entirely in your browser.

tic-tac-toe.NAME: Tic Tac Toe
tic-tac-toe.DESCRIPTION: Play Tic Tac Toe against a friend or challenge the unbeatable AI.
tic-tac-toe.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Play the classic Tic Tac Toe game in your browser. Challenge a friend in local multiplayer mode or face an unbeatable CPU opponent powered by the minimax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning.

typing-speed.NAME: Typing Speed Test
typing-speed.DESCRIPTION: Measure your words per minute (WPM) and accuracy while typing Italian texts.
typing-speed.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Test your typing speed and accuracy with curated Italian text passages. Get your WPM (words per minute), characters per minute and error rate instantly. No account or registration required.

reaction-time.NAME: Reaction Time Test
reaction-time.DESCRIPTION: Measure your reaction time in milliseconds using the traffic light or random event test.
reaction-time.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Test your reaction time in milliseconds with two modes: traffic light (following road rules: off → red → yellow → green) and a random event test. Compare your results against averages and track improvements.

CF_INVERSO.TITLE: Decode Fiscal Code
CF_INVERSO.SUBTITLE: Decode any Italian fiscal code and extract the encoded personal data: surname consonants, name consonants, birth year, month, day, gender and birth municipality code.
CF_INVERSO.DESCRIPTION: This tool decodes an Italian fiscal code and shows birth year, month, day, gender, and birth municipality or cadastral code.
CF_INVERSO.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Paste an Italian fiscal code and this tool parses its structure to extract the encoded data: birth year, month and day, gender, and birth municipality or cadastral code. Validation runs directly in your browser.

CODICE_FISCALE.TITLE: Italian Tax Code Calculator
CODICE_FISCALE.SUBTITLE: Calculate and generate an Italian fiscal code (codice fiscale) from name, surname, date of birth, gender and municipality — using the official Agenzia delle Entrate algorithm.
CODICE_FISCALE.RESULT_PLACEHOLDER: Fill the form to generate the tax code

BASE64.TITLE: Base64 / UnBase64
BASE64.SUBTITLE: Encode plain text to Base64 and decode Base64 strings back to readable text. Useful for data URIs, HTTP Basic Auth headers, email attachments and binary-safe data transmission.
BASE64.RESULT_PLACEHOLDER: Insert a plain text or Base64 string

IBAN.TITLE: IBAN Checker
IBAN.SUBTITLE: Validate any IBAN (International Bank Account Number) by computing the mod-97 checksum. Covers 40+ countries. All validation runs client-side — no bank data is ever sent to any server.
IBAN.NOTE: Validates only the check digit (format + mod-97). Does not verify that the account actually exists.

CF_CHECK.TITLE: Codice Fiscale Checker
CF_CHECK.SUBTITLE: Verify an Italian fiscal code (codice fiscale) by checking the regex format pattern and the Luhn-like control character. All computation happens entirely in your browser.
CF_CHECK.PLACEHOLDER: Enter a fiscal code and press Check
CF_CHECK.NOTE: Only checks the control character. Does not verify registry existence.

JWT.TITLE: JWT Decoder
JWT.SUBTITLE: Decode, inspect and optionally verify JSON Web Tokens (JWT). View the header algorithm, payload claims and expiry — then verify the signature with your HMAC secret or RSA public key.
JWT.UNSUPPORTED_ALG: Signature verification is not supported for algorithm: {{alg}}

ONE_LINE.TITLE: To one line
ONE_LINE.SUBTITLE: Collapse multi-line text into a single line and remove extra whitespace. Ideal for cleaning up SQL queries, JSON strings or any multiline content before pasting into terminals or commands.

SPACE_REMOVER.TITLE: Space remover
SPACE_REMOVER.SUBTITLE: Strip all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) from any text instantly — useful for compact identifiers, checksums, hashes or code cleanup.
SPACE_REMOVER.ONLY_DOUBLE: Remove only double spaces (keep single spaces)

STRING_LENGTH.TITLE: String length
STRING_LENGTH.SUBTITLE: Count characters (with and without spaces), words, lines and the UTF-8 byte size of any text. Useful for enforcing API field limits, checking SMS or tweet lengths and string analysis.

URL_CODEC.TITLE: URL Encode / Decode
URL_CODEC.SUBTITLE: Percent-encode and decode URLs and query parameters. Convert special characters like spaces, &, = and + to their %XX notation and back — essential for building safe API requests.

UNITS.TITLE: Unit converter
UNITS.SUBTITLE: Convert between the SI metric system and US customary units in real time. Supports length, mass, volume, temperature and speed with instant bidirectional conversion.

JSON_FORMATTER.TITLE: JSON Formatter
JSON_FORMATTER.SUBTITLE: Format, minify and validate JSON documents online. Paste raw or minified JSON to get instant pretty-print with configurable indentation and inline syntax error detection.

JSON_YAML.TITLE: JSON ↔ YAML
JSON_YAML.SUBTITLE: Convert documents between JSON and YAML in both directions. Useful for Kubernetes configs, CI/CD pipelines, OpenAPI specs and API payload transformation.

JSON_CSV.TITLE: JSON ↔ CSV
JSON_CSV.SUBTITLE: Convert between JSON arrays of objects and CSV format. Export API responses as spreadsheets or import CSV data as JSON for further processing.

EPOCH.TITLE: Epoch / Unix Timestamp
EPOCH.SUBTITLE: Convert between Unix epoch timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) and human-readable dates. Shows the current timestamp in real time and supports custom date-to-epoch conversion.

HASH.TITLE: Password / string hashes
HASH.SUBTITLE: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and bcrypt hashes of any text — entirely in your browser using the Web Crypto API. No data is sent to any server.
HASH.SALT_HINT: The salt is prepended to the input before hashing. bcrypt generates its own salt automatically.
HASH.BCRYPT_ROUNDS_HINT: Higher cost = slower hash. 10 is a common default.
HASH.BCRYPT_SALT_NOTE: Each bcrypt hash embeds a unique random salt — the same input produces a different hash each time.

PWGEN.TITLE: Password Generator
PWGEN.SUBTITLE: Generate strong random passwords using a cryptographically secure number generator (CSPRNG). Choose length, character sets and exclusions — with an instant entropy strength score.
PWGEN.CRYPTO_NOTE: Produced with a cryptographically secure random number generator.

MY_IP.TITLE: My IP
MY_IP.SUBTITLE: Discover your public IP address instantly. Note: this is the only tool on this site that makes an external network request (to api.ipify.org). All other tools run fully offline.
MY_IP.WARNING: Clicking the button sends a request to api.ipify.org to retrieve your public IP. This is the only tool on this site that performs an external network request. No other data is sent to any server.

CRON.TITLE: Cron Expression Builder

PERCENTAGE.TITLE: Percentage Calculator

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.SUBTITLE: Privacy notice pursuant to EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).
PRIVACY.SECTION_OWNER_SUB: Who is responsible for your data
PRIVACY.OWNER_BODY: The data controller for piu-di-100-tool.it is the project maintainer, reachable via the project's GitHub repository. No Data Protection Officer (DPO) has been appointed as the controller does not fall within the categories required by Art. 37 GDPR.
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_BODY: Due to the client-side nature of this site, the amount of data processed is kept to a strict minimum:
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_ITEM_1: Navigation data: your IP address and HTTP request metadata are processed temporarily by the hosting infrastructure to ensure service availability and security. They are not retained long-term or linked to an identity.
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_ITEM_2: Local preferences: the selected language is stored in the browser's localStorage, solely on your device.
PRIVACY.DATA_COLLECTED_ITEM_3: My IP tool: if you use the "My IP" tool, your browser sends a GET request to api.ipify.org (a third-party service) which receives your public IP address.
PRIVACY.SECTION_CLIENT_SIDE_SUB: Your data never leaves the browser
PRIVACY.CLIENT_BODY: Every tool on this site — calculators, formatters, converters, generators — runs entirely in your browser via JavaScript. Data entered in forms (text, JSON, IBANs, fiscal codes, passwords, JWTs, images, etc.) is never transmitted to a server.
PRIVACY.CLIENT_ITEM_1: No processed data is sent to the controller's servers.
PRIVACY.CLIENT_ITEM_2: No server-side logs of data entered in tools.
PRIVACY.CLIENT_ITEM_3: Closing the page or browser removes all data in use.
PRIVACY.LEGAL_BASIS_BODY: Processing is grounded on the following legal bases:
PRIVACY.LEGAL_BASIS_ITEM_1: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – Legitimate interest: navigation data processed by hosting is strictly necessary for security and proper operation of the service.
PRIVACY.LEGAL_BASIS_ITEM_2: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – Performance of a service: the "My IP" tool requires contacting api.ipify.org in order to function. The request is made exclusively upon explicit user action.
PRIVACY.LEGAL_BASIS_ITEM_3: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – Performance of a service: local preferences (e.g. language) are stored solely in your interest to deliver the requested service.
PRIVACY.SECTION_THIRD_PARTY_SUB: Only api.ipify.org in the My IP tool
PRIVACY.THIRD_PARTY_BODY: The "My IP" tool transmits your IP address to api.ipify.org, an external service not controlled by the data controller. Its use is entirely optional.
PRIVACY.THIRD_PARTY_DETAIL: No other personal data is transferred to third parties. Please consult ipify.org's privacy policy for details on how that service processes data. This site is also served via a third-party hosting infrastructure whose provider acts as a data processor (Art. 28 GDPR) under standard contractual terms.
PRIVACY.NO_TRACKING_BODY: This site uses no tracking or profiling tools:
PRIVACY.NO_TRACKING_ITEM_2: No analytics services (Google Analytics, Matomo, or similar).
PRIVACY.COOKIES_BODY: This site does not set any cookies and does not use localStorage or sessionStorage. No data is stored in the browser between sessions.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_ITEM_1: localStorage: stores the language preference. Can be deleted at any time from your browser settings.
PRIVACY.COOKIES_ITEM_2: sessionStorage: used by some tools to maintain temporary state within the current session. Contains no personal data and is cleared when the tab is closed.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY: Navigation data processed by hosting is retained only as long as strictly necessary for service security, generally no longer than 30 days. No personal data is stored on the controller's servers.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_BODY: To the extent personal data concerning you is processed, you have the right to:
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_1: Access (Art. 15): obtain confirmation that data is being processed and receive a copy.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_2: Rectification (Art. 16): request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_3: Erasure (Art. 17): request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten").
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_4: Restriction (Art. 18): request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_5: Portability (Art. 20): receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_6: Objection (Art. 21): object to processing based on legitimate interest.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_ITEM_7: Withdrawal of consent (Art. 7): withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS_FOOTER: To exercise your rights, contact the controller at privacy@piu-di-100-tool.it or open an issue on GitHub. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in Italy: www.garanteprivacy.it).
PRIVACY.CHANGES_BODY: The controller reserves the right to update this notice to reflect regulatory or operational changes. The last updated date is shown at the top of the page. We recommend checking this page periodically.
PRIVACY.CONTACT_BODY: For any privacy-related request or to exercise your rights, contact us at:
